jobs.title: Director, Collections Strategy & Performance
jobs.description:
Join one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies and be part of something extraordinary – welcome to goeasy
! At goeasy, our people and culture are at the heart of everything we do, and we’re proud to be recognized for it. We’ve earned prestigious accolades such as Waterstone Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures
and Canada’s Top Growing Companies
. We’re also honoured to be named a Greater Toronto Top Employer
and recognized by Great Place to Work®
as having the Best Workplaces for Women
& Most Trusted Executive Teams
, and included on TIME Magazine’s 2025 list of Canada’s Best Companies
. These honours reflect our commitment to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where talent thrives and innovation drives us forward.

As one of Canada’s leading alternative consumer lenders, we’re passionate about helping everyday Canadians create a brighter future. Our vision is to provide a path to a better tomorrow, today. We offer a full range of products, including non-prime leasing, unsecured and secured loans, and point-of-sale financing through easyhome
, easyfinancial
, and LendCare
.
If you're seeking an exciting, high-growth environment where your contributions truly matter, we want to hear from you! Join us, and together, let's create a future of financial empowerment.

About The Role

At goeasy, we believe everyone deserves access to fair and responsible credit. Every day, we help Canadians who are building or rebuilding their financial future access the products and support they need to move forward with confidence. We're looking for a Director, Collections Strategy & Performance
who understands that Collections is about more than recoveries. It's about finding the right balance between customer outcomes, responsible lending, risk management, and business performance. We are looking for a strategic and analytical problem solver who can use data, insights, and sound business judgment to identify opportunities and improve how we operate.

This is not a traditional Collections Director role.

You'll have the opportunity to influence strategy, lead transformation, and help shape the future of one of goeasy's most important functions. With significant autonomy and visibility, you'll partner across Operations, Analytics, Technology, Risk, and Compliance to build better experiences for customers while driving strong business results.

What You'll Do

Help define and execute the strategy for a critical part of goeasy's business.
Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes, portfolio performance, and operational effectiveness.
Lead initiatives across Collections, Recoveries, Third-Party Partners, Offshore Operations, Technology, and Analytics.
Use data and insights to inform decisions and influence business strategy.
Diagnose complex and ambiguous business problems, identify underlying performance drivers, and develop practical solutions.
Translate analysis and insights into clear recommendations, priorities, and execution plans.
Develop performance frameworks, reporting, and operating rhythms that improve visibility, decision-making, and accountability.
Strengthen risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance practices.
Build and improve processes that create better experiences for customers and employees.
Develop high-performing teams and future leaders.
Bring new ideas, challenge assumptions, and help drive the next phase of goeasy's evolution.

What We're Looking For

8-15 years of leadership experience in Collections, Operations, Strategy, Risk Management, Financial Services, Consulting, Analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to turn complex information into clear business insights and recommendations.
Demonstrated experience solving ambiguous business problems and identifying the underlying drivers of performance.
Strong business judgment, curiosity, and a practical, outcomes-oriented approach.
Experience leading large-scale business improvements and transformational change.
Strong business acumen, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to connect strategy with execution and lead initiatives from analysis through implementation.
Ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and regulatory requirements.
Experience in Collections, call centre operations, third-party vendors, agencies, or offshore partners is considered an asset but is not required.

We offer a Flexible Work Program that provides you the ability to work three days onsite per week
, from our Mississauga office.

Internal Applicants:
please apply through the link and provide written endorsement from your current manager.

Why should you work for goeasy?

Financial Benefits

In keeping with our mission to create better tomorrows for our employees, each year goeasy commits to continuously enhancing its total rewards. Here are some of the perks we offer:
Performance-based annual bonus and long-term equity incentives designed to support leadership impact and long-term wealth creation.
As a TSX-listed company (GSY), goeasy offers long-term equity incentives, giving team members the opportunity to contribute to and benefit from our continued success.
Employee discounts on furniture, electronics, and appliances.
MAT & PAT leave top-up.

Leadership & Career Growth

Access to high-impact, high-visibility roles with direct influence on business outcomes.
Participation in goeasy’s executive leadership development programs.
Lead your own development journey with personalized growth plans, supported by coaching and mentorship to help you reach your leadership goals.
Fuel your personal and professional growth with our Tuition Assistance Program.

Health and Lifestyle

Immediate enrollment in comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
Access 24/7 healthcare with Virtual Doctor Appointments.
Exclusive access to our free on-site goeasy gym and fitness studio at head office.
Explore a wide range of wellness options through our new Wellhub benefit – from fitness memberships to mental health resources.
Enjoy a state-of-the-art office space with perks like a games room, healthy snack program, free gated parking.
Give back with company-paid volunteer days and Company Matched Charitable Donations.

Diversity, Inclusion, And Equal Opportunity Employment

At goeasy, we believe that we can only be the best when people are able to bring their best selves to work every day. goeasy is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process. Please let the talent acquisition team know if you require an accommodation during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

Additional Information

All candidates considered for hire must successfully pass a criminal background check, credit check, and validation of their work experience to qualify for hire. We thank all interested applicants; however, we will only be contacting those for interview who possess the skills and qualifications outlined above.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Supply Chain Finance - Canada
jobs.description:
Job Description

Associate Director, Supply Chain Finance Canada at a glance...

Location: Toronto, ON

Hybrid: 3 days/week

The Associate Director, Supply Chain Finance Canada is the central supply chain finance person within North America that provides broad business and financial counsel to the Canada CFO & Head of Operations Canada. This role will work to increase visibility into supply chain performance across the country & drive actions/cost savings. This individual will work under the direction of the CFO. This role will lead teams in rituals and routines, process improvements, and cost savings initiatives in addition to assisting in the budget, forecast, and results reporting process.

What’s on the menu?

Aggregate total Operation's P&L performance (including Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics) reports and compile consolidated deck for Canada Leadership review
Review report submissions and challenge and direct assumptions, commentary and forecasts
Support accurate P&L and publishing of financial presentations ranging from consolidated financials, flash reports, and other reports necessary to help drive optimal decision making.
Prepare standard and ad-hoc analysis, driving insight on business gaps to plan and benchmarks and validate future strategic opportunities.
Lead the monthly performance review and annual budgeting process
Serve as an advocate in financial planning and accounting matters (e.g., financial reporting, cost allocations)
Support business by providing ad-hoc and structured reporting mechanisms to provide insight into costs
Identify gaps/improve Supply Chain Finance organization capabilities in order to drive value to wider organization
Manage 1 plant controller & local plant team
Drive efficiencies and results across multiple manufacturing facilities, external manufacturers, procurement and logistics

Recipe for success – apply now if this sounds like you!

BS in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration required MBA preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in Finance/Accounting
Strong business acumen, interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills
Demonstrated ability to multitask and make key decisions, managing multiple projects concurrently with limited direct supervision.
Ability to influence cross-functional team members
Motivated self-starter who can effectively work under pressure and manage multiple priorities
Possesses the ability to lead teams and effectively work through others
Team player who manages collaboratively with the ability to influence management, in some cases without authority
Ability to recognize opportunities to simplify processes and create efficiencies
Strong Technical and Systems orientation, experience with Hyperion and SAP desired
Prior Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics or FP&A experience desired

Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values.

New Hire Base Salary Range

$181,000.00 - $210,000.00

Bonus:
This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.

The compensation offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors

Benefits:
Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future, we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Coverage for benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.

Wellbeing:
We offer events, resources, and learning opportunities that inspire a physical, social, emotional, and financial well-being lifestyle for our employees and their families.

Benefits

You’ll be able to participate in a variety of benefits and wellbeing programs that may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors, for example:

Physical - Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental, Vision, Screenings/Assessments
Social - Paid Time Off, Company Holidays, Leave of Absence, Flexible Work Arrangements, Recognition, Training
Emotional – Employee Family Assistance Program, Wellbeing Programs, Family Support Programs
Financial -Savings/Pension, Life, Accidental Death & Dismemberment, Disability, Discounted Perks

Location(s)

Toronto - Queen's Quay - Headquarters

Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.
In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for protected individuals, applicants that require accommodation in the job application process may contact NAZTAOps@kraftheinz.com for assistance.
